description: Original South Asian secular fruit and dessert-inspired candy items for the 50-level expansion.

candies.name: Himsagar Mango Drop
candies.silhouette: Plump curved mango teardrop with glossy saffron-gold glaze and mint leaf tip
candies.regionalOrigin: Rajshahi (Bangladesh) & Malda (West Bengal, India) mango orchards
candies.specialBoardProperty: Matching 4+ Mango Drops near Sticky Sap or Mud Bog coats 1 adjacent tile in slick nectar, speeding up falling mission keys by 2x.

candies.name: Dinajpur Ruby Litchi
candies.silhouette: Textured crimson-pink shell cracked slightly at the crown to reveal a glowing pearlescent white core
candies.regionalOrigin: Dinajpur (Bangladesh) & Muzaffarpur (Bihar, India) summer litchi groves
candies.specialBoardProperty: Generates +20% bonus rescue winch charge when matched in vertical columns.

candies.name: Floating Market Guava Crisp
candies.silhouette: Beveled emerald-rind round medallion with coral-pink inner pulp and tiny golden seed dots
candies.regionalOrigin: Barisal backwater floating guava markets (Bangladesh) & Allahabad orchards (India)
candies.specialBoardProperty: Naturally buoyant in Monsoon Floodwater rows — resists sinking traps and reinforces wooden bridges.

candies.name: Honeyed Jackfruit Pod
candies.silhouette: Glossy ribbed golden-amber fruit bulb with plump segmented ridges
candies.regionalOrigin: Madhupur & Gazipur orchards (Bangladesh) & Kerala/Assam jackfruit groves (India)
candies.specialBoardProperty: Heavyweight candy: deals +1 bonus impact vibration to adjacent Bamboo Cages when matched in L/T shapes.

candies.name: Monsoon Jamun Berry
candies.silhouette: Smooth elongated deep-violet plum gem with iridescent indigo specular rim
candies.regionalOrigin: Rural monsoon orchard avenues across Bengal and northern India
candies.specialBoardProperty: Releases cooling purple juice splash on match that neutralizes 1 stack of Chili-Sugar Ember heat.

candies.name: Daab Coconut Splash Cube
candies.silhouette: Rounded aqua-green tender coconut shell with a glossy white cream rim and water-droplet emblem
candies.regionalOrigin: St. Martin's Island, Cox's Bazar & coastal Malabar/Andaman groves
candies.specialBoardProperty: Sprays clear coconut water 1 tile orthogonally when popped inside a Wrapped combo, washing away Sticky Slime.

candies.name: Foothill Mandarin Crescent
candies.silhouette: Translucent tangerine citrus wedge with glowing pulp vesicles
candies.regionalOrigin: Sylhet citrus hills & Darjeeling/Sikkim foothill orchards
candies.specialBoardProperty: Zest burst clears Tea Mist clouds in a 1-tile radius around the match.

candies.name: Saffron Pistachio Kulfi
candies.silhouette: Faceted conical creamy kulfi pop speckled with emerald pistachio shards on a tiny bamboo stick
candies.regionalOrigin: Old Dhaka & Delhi/Kolkata summer street kulfi carts
candies.specialBoardProperty: Crafted or spawned in thermal levels: matching chills approaching Lava Crawlers (-8% danger) or freezes 1 Caramel Lava spout for 2 turns.

candies.name: Golden Syrup Jilapi Coil
candies.silhouette: Luminous 3D pretzel-spiral coil of crispy saffron-orange syrup tubing
candies.regionalOrigin: Riverbank fairs and everyday sweet shops across Bangladesh and India
candies.specialBoardProperty: Acts as a spiral energy relay: when hit by any Striped blast, re-emits a ring pulse hitting all 8 surrounding tiles.

candies.name: Cloud-Soft Rasgulla Orb
candies.silhouette: Luminous dimpled snow-white sponge sphere glistening with clear sugar syrup
candies.regionalOrigin: Bengal dairy sweetmaking tradition (Bangladesh & West Bengal)
candies.specialBoardProperty: Cushion physics: matching Rasgulla Orbs inflates Mochi's safety airbag bumper, absorbing 1 falling shale rock or crusher shock.
